column2: (3)  (a)  Every  office  bearer  of  the  Board  of  Trustees

column2: (b) In the event of a vacancy occurring due to the death,

column1: resignation, incapacity or removal from office of an office

column2: (c) The person elected or appointed under paragraph (b)
